page.title: Shifts
page.off: The shift system is not switched on yet. It is opening gradually, one rikma at a time.
page.shadow: Trial mode: declarations are saved and the roster is computed, but it is not sent to anyone and does not bind anyone yet.
page.loadError: We could not load the shifts right now. The rest of the rikma works as usual.
page.empty: This rikma has no mission with a staffing plan yet.
page.emptyHint: A staffing plan is made from a mission: in the mission form, mark that it needs to be staffed at set hours.
page.notOnMission: You are not on this mission, so there is nothing for you to declare here. To take part, ask to join the mission.

phase.upcoming: Declarations for this cycle open on {{date}}
phase.declaring: Declarations are open. The draft is published on {{date}}
phase.draft: The draft is out. You can release, swap or volunteer until {{date}}
phase.closed: The roster for this cycle is closed

grid.tapHint: Tap a shift to move between: want to → can → if needed → can't. The star marks a top choice.
grid.saveError: The change was not saved. Please try again.

roster.noDraft: The roster appears here once the draft is published.
roster.shadowNote: Trial roster: this is what the roster would look like. It has not been sent to anyone and binds nobody.

reason.onlyCandidate: The only one who declared for this shift
reason.ownPreference: Marked it as a top choice
reason.belowQuota: Furthest below their share this cycle
reason.owed: Got less than their share in earlier cycles
reason.tieBreak: A fixed draw between exactly equal candidates
reason.overQuota: Beyond their share — nobody else was available; it evens out next cycle
reason.backup: In line — called if someone releases
reason.volunteered: Volunteered for a shift that was short
reason.swapped: A swap both sides agreed to
reason.cover: Stepped in for someone who released

fairness.intro: Everyone gets the same number of shifts, except where their own commitment caps them lower or lifts them higher.
fairness.noSnapshot: Shares are computed when this cycle's draft is published.
fairness.shortage: {{count}} shifts are not covered by any commitment in the rikma — a call to fill the holes will open.
fairness.carryHelp: Positive: got more than their share before, so the next share is smaller. Negative: is owed.

why.belowMin: Below the minimum — not enough shifts this cycle

form.enable: This mission needs to be staffed at set hours
form.enableHint: Tick this if someone has to be here at certain hours. The rikma approves the staffing hours together with the mission, and whoever joins arranges shifts among themselves.
form.noWindows: Mark at least one day with a time window.
form.invalid: {{count}} fields in the hours are not valid — check the start, the end and the number of people.
form.hoursPerPerson: How many hours a week will one person give?
form.closeOffsetHours: Hours before the cycle the draft is published
form.advancedHint: An empty field means the rikma's default.
form.fixBeforeSend: The staffing plan is incomplete — finish it or untick it before publishing.
form.planNotSaved: The mission was created, but its staffing plan was not saved. You can add it again.

join.hint: How many shifts per cycle (usually a week) can you take? It is part of your joining terms, like hours and rate — and later it changes only by the rikma's vote.

declare.body: The cycle {{range}} is open for declarations. You haven't answered {{count}} shifts yet — when can you come?
declare.deadline: You can declare until {{date}}. "I can't" is a full answer too.

draft.body: The draft is out. Here is your place in it, and why. If you don't respond by {{date}}, it closes as it is.
draft.release: I can't make it after all
draft.released: Your place was released and the next person in line was told
draft.holes: The draft still has {{count}} uncovered places

hole.body: This shift still needs {{count}} more people.
hole.nextInLine: You're next in line as backup for this shift
hole.spare: You have room for {{count}} more shifts under what you agreed to
hole.clashes: You already have a shift that overlaps this one
hole.taken: Thank you! The shift is yours
hole.reopen: Open the mission to one more candidate
hole.reopened: The mission is open to one more candidate
hole.alreadyReopened: The mission was already opened to another candidate this cycle
hole.silenceNote: If nobody takes this shift before the cycle closes, the mission opens to another candidate on its own.

cards.error: That didn't go through. Please try again.

swap.counteredBy: {{name}} proposed a different version of the swap you offered.
swap.silenceCompletes: You said you can make this shift, so if you don't answer by {{date}}, the swap goes ahead.
swap.silenceLapses: The swap happens only if you approve. With no answer by {{date}}, the roster stays as it is.
swap.askInstead: What to ask for in return
swap.done: The swap is done and the roster updated
swap.lapsed: The roster changed in the meantime, so the swap was not made
swap.panelHint: Doesn't suit you? You can offer the shift to another member on the mission — and ask for one of theirs in return.
swap.sent: Offer sent. The swap happens only if they approve.
swap.sentSilence: Offer sent. Since they said they can make it, silence by the deadline completes it.

problem.giveNotYours: You can only offer your own shift
problem.takeMissing: The shift you asked for was not found
problem.takeNotTheirs: The shift you asked for is not this member's
problem.notComing: Only a place you are coming to can be swapped, not a place in line
problem.notOnMission: You can only swap with someone assigned to the mission
problem.clash: The swap would leave someone in two overlapping shifts
problem.alreadyThere: This member is already coming to that shift
problem.noPlan: The shift plan was not found

hours.startingBody: A shift does not count as hours by itself. Starting the mission timer records what you actually work.
hours.noTimer: The mission timer has not loaded yet. You can start it from the timers page.
hours.logBody: The shift ended and no timer ran. Log {{hours}} hours?
hours.logged: The hours were logged and sent for approval
hours.notWorkedDone: Noted that the shift was not worked
hours.approvalNote: The hours go to the rikma for approval like any other hours.
